No towering jagged Alps, no glacier or snow, no cabins, no basilica, no road lighting. Central lake basin and enclosing slopes framed coherently for both wide16:9 and central4:5 crop. Restrained long-exposure ambient night interpretation, dark desaturated natural stone and grass barely readable, no invented directional spotlight, no luminous turquoise lake.
